Introduction

Xiaoting is a Chinese singer and dancer best known as a member of the South Korean girl group Kep1er, formed through the Mnet survival show Girls Planet 999 in 2021.

She first gained public attention in 2020 when she participated in the Chinese survival program Produce Camp 2020 (also known as Chuang 2020). Despite showing early promise, she was eliminated in the fourth episode, ranking 80th overall.

In 2021, Xiaoting returned to the idol scene through Girls Planet 999, representing the C-Group. Throughout the program, she maintained a consistently high ranking, becoming the only contestant to hold first place within her group for the entire season. She remained a part of the Planet Top 9 throughout the competition and ultimately placed ninth in the finale, earning her place in the final lineup of Kep1er.

Kep1er officially debuted on January 3, 2022, with the mini album "First Impact" and the title track "WA DA DA". The group's debut was a commercial success, and Xiaoting has since continued her activities with the group under WAKEONE, contributing to their growing influence in the global kpop market.
